text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Starting canary rls-2026-03-15 -> prod (canary=canary-71, 5% traffic). Feature toggle ff/async-ingest enabled for canary.
carla-oncall: getting paged by customers reporting 503s on ingestion endpoints. Alerting now.
sam-sre: error rate on canary-71 jumped from 0.2% to ~9% within 2 minutes. traces show repeated read/write timeouts to object-store backend.
ops-bot: automated rollback policy evaluated: metric-window aggregator missed a few samples during a collection rotation which resulted in an under-threshold eval. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T13:58:02Z] agg: samples_missing=3 window=60s
[2026-03-15T13:58:03Z] policy: error_rate=4.7% threshold=5.0% -> NO_ROLLBACK
```
mohit-eng: we should flip the emergency flag now: ff/async-ingest -> false. That should stop new writes through this path.
carla-oncall: agreed. Steps to mitigate quickly:
1) Flip ff/async-ingest False (console/API)
2) Reduce traffic weight to 0 for canary-71
3) Run cross-region smoke checks and confirm reduction in 5xx
4) Start customer impact triage (support)

mohit-eng: flipping flag via API (mohit-eng). Propagation reported by flag service.
deploy-bot: flag-change recorded: ff/async-ingest set to false by mohit-eng at 2026-03-15T13:59:12Z :white_check_mark:
sam-sre: initiating drain: set routing weight canary-71 -> 0. watching for inflight completions.
sam-sre: smoke check (run from us-east and eu-west):
```
curl -sS -H "X-Test-Org: test-org" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -d '{"batch":[]}' -w '\n%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n'
# expect 200 and < 300ms
```
smoke results: us-east -> 200 0.196s  | eu-west -> 200 0.221s
carla-oncall: 503s have dropped to baseline ~0.15%. Good. Ivy-support, begin collecting impacted org IDs and windows.
ivy-support: initial customer-impact: 9 enterprise tenants saw intermittent 503/504 between 13:58 and 14:06 UTC on ingest endpoints. compiling list now.
mohit-eng: quick root-cause summary: new canary image had environment variable INGEST_S3_ENDPOINT pointing to a staging S3 proxy which required a VPC endpoint that's absent in prod; requests stalled and timed out. code path ok, config+infra mismatch caused failure.
mohit-eng: mitigation plan:
- revert INGEST_S3_ENDPOINT to the previous production value in config repo (merged)
- publish patched canary image canary-71-fix and run at 1% with tighter rollback thresholds
- add canary preflight to validate S3 endpoint resolution
carla-oncall: rollback verification checklist:
- [ ] canary routing weight = 0
- [ ] 5xx < 0.5% for 5 min
- [ ] smoke tests from 3 regions pass
- [ ] impacted org logs cleared / no new errors
- [ ] flag-change and drain events recorded in audit
sam-sre: routing weight shows 0 at 14:01:05Z. 5xx at 0.12% currently.
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-7890 created and linked by carla-oncall. severity=SEV2.
elaine-pm: recommend postmortem and action items: make aggregator sampling robust (don't miss windows), add feature-flag canary gating by endpoint probe, and include S3 endpoint validation in release checklist.
carla-oncall: publishing customer-facing note draft to enterprise channel. support please verify impacted org list and send PSAT with timeframe.
ivy-support: draft: "We experienced intermittent ingestion errors affecting a small number of enterprise customers during a canary deployment. We disabled the feature flag and drained the canary; services have recovered. We are issuing a follow-up with root cause and remediation steps."
carla-oncall: good. add exact window (13:58-14:06 UTC) and list of tenant IDs before sending.
mohit-eng: will push the fixed canary at 14:20 and run a tight canary: 1% for 3 minutes with rollback if error_rate > 1% in 30s.
carla-oncall: handing off continued monitoring to infra-oncall (sam-sre). leaving thread open until post-fix verification completes. will close after customer comms go out.
carla-oncall: immediate mitigation completed (flag off + drain). closing in 1 hour if stable. :white_check_mark:
